programs.title: The Hub With Wang Guan
programs.desc: The Hub with Wang Guan covers hot-button geopolitical and economic issues, as well as interesting stories and trends in culture, education, technology and lifestyle. It also makes use of trending topics online, while focusing on what’s relevant in China and the world.
